title: Part
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. This sketch consists of a single loop made up of twelve lines. The first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and extends to (0.0976, 0.0). The second line then moves vertically to (0.0976, 0.0039), followed by a horizontal line to (0.1048, 0.0039). Continue with a vertical line to (0.1048, 0.0097), then a horizontal line back to (0.0833, 0.0097). The next line slopes down to (0.0793, 0.0136), followed by a horizontal line to (0.0, 0.0136). Move vertically down to (0.0, 0.0097), then horizontally to (0.0086, 0.0097). The tenth line is a vertical drop to (0.0086, 0.0039), followed by a horizontal line to (0.0, 0.0039), and finally, a vertical line back to the origin. After completing the sketch, apply a scaling factor of 0.1048 to the entire two-dimensional sketch. Transform the scaled sketch into three dimensions by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero and translating it with a vector also set to zero. Finally, extrude the two-dimensional sketch along its normal by 0.75 units to create a solid body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical object with a rectangular cross-section and rounded edges are a length of 0.10478468899521531 units, a width of 0.01363636363636364 units, and a height of 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.0976, 0).lineTo(0.0976, 0.0039).lineTo(0.1048, 0.0039).lineTo(0.1048, 0.0097).lineTo(0.0833, 0.0097).lineTo(0.0793, 0.0136).lineTo(0.0, 0.0136).lineTo(0.0, 0.0097).lineTo(0.0086, 0.0097).lineTo(0.0086, 0.0039).lineTo(0.0, 0.0039).close()

# Extrude the sketch
extruded_shape = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# The final model
r = extruded_shape

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Base plate: X=0.1048, Y=0.0136, Z=0.7500
base = cq.Workplane("XY").box(0.1048, 0.0136, 0.7500, centered=(False, False, False))

# Small tab protruding on the right side (+Y) near the far X end
tab = cq.Workplane("XY").box(0.0148, 0.0050, 0.7500, centered=(False, False, False)) \
    .translate((0.0900, 0.0136, 0.0))

# Notch cut into the left face (-Y side) near the near X end
notch = cq.Workplane("XY").box(0.0200, 0.0068, 0.7500, centered=(False, False, False)) \
    .translate((0.0, 0.0068, 0.0))

r = base.union(tab).cut(notch)

lanes.label: Kimi K3 (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Long thin strip (Z = 0.75 tall) whose cross-section in XY is a plate
# 0.1048 wide x 0.0136 thick, with a full-thickness flange rib along the
# right edge and a small notch detail at the left end.

profile = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0.0, 0.0025)
    .lineTo(0.098, 0.0025)          # bottom face of main plate
    .lineTo(0.098, 0.0)             # step down to flange
    .lineTo(0.1048, 0.0)            # flange bottom
    .lineTo(0.1048, 0.0136)         # flange outer edge (full thickness)
    .lineTo(0.098, 0.0136)          # flange top
    .lineTo(0.098, 0.0111)          # step up from flange
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.0111)            # top face of main plate
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.0086)            # small notch at left end
    .lineTo(0.002, 0.0086)
    .lineTo(0.002, 0.0050)
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.0050)
    .close()
)

r = profile.extrude(0.75)
